description: This file defines a configuration class for interfacing with Anthropic's Claude models via Amazon Bedrock, including request transformation, response handling, and tool normalization specific to the Claude models. It extends base classes for invoke configuration and Anthropic-specific configurations, providing model parameter mapping, request filtering, and beta feature handling.

classes.name: AmazonAnthropicClaudeConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for managing requests and responses for Amazon Bedrock's Anthropic Claude models, including parameter mapping, request filtering, and beta feature handling.

methods.name: Optional[str] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns the name of the custom LLM provider, fixed as 'bedrock'.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns supported openai parameters for the model, delegating to the base AnthropicConfig class.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps openai parameters to model-specific parameters, delegating to the base class.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms and filters request parameters, prepares the request payload including beta features, and handles tool normalization.

methods.name: dict _normalize_bedrock_tool_search_tools(self, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Normalizes tool search entries in optional parameters, converting specific types to Bedrock-supported formats.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw response into a ModelResponse, delegating to the base AnthropicConfig class.
